title: Skincare for Night Shift Workers: A Simple Routine That Follows Your Sleep
ex: Work nights? Put your night cream on before your main sleep, wear sunscreen on the ride home, and protect skin from AC, screens and broken sleep.
rt: Skincare for Night Shift Workers: Simple Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skincare for night shift workers in India: when to apply night cream if you sleep in the day, sunscreen for the ride home, AC dryness and tired-looking eyes.
quick: Follow your sleep, not the clock. Apply night cream before your main sleep, even if that is in the morning, wear sunscreen whenever you are out in daylight such as the ride home, and use a light moisturiser against dry office AC during the shift.
facts: Apply night cream before your main sleep
Sunscreen only for hours in daylight
Office AC dries skin through a shift
Sleep and water matter more than any cream
